utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the twentieth of August. Have we got everyone on Teams?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm here. Only just, mind. Traffic on the ring road was absolutely solid.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Same queue, different Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'm hoping it clears up for the weekend. Meant to be going camping, but that weather forecast's looking properly grim.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Camping? In this? Brave.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's one word for it. Anyway, yes, I'm here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Quick bit on what's already finished, then the actual jobs.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, I signed off the inspection on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve on Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's fully closed, then? Not something hanging over from Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Fully closed. Just reporting it, nothing new there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the Site Water System on Tuesday. That one's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One observation from me: saw the pressure on the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: It recovered without anyone changing anything?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah. Just an observation for this meeting, not allocating a job off that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing here. I saw the pressure on the relief valve dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You're just reporting what you saw, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. Not proposing any work on it.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the water booster. Still blocked, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays blocked. No new chasing action out of this meeting.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Oh, and we were going to replace the belt on the line one but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, because that's still on the old printout. Definitely not today's work?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Definitely not. Pushed to next month.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you run the monthly fire alarm test next week? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test next week. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Amazing how that sound still makes everyone jump, even when they're expecting it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Marc, can you send the shift handover report round tomorrow? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll send the shift handover report round tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the existing handover report, isn't it? Not a different version?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Just the existing one, yeah. Nothing fancy.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you also do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor next week? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, I can do that. I'll do the site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor next week.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Full name, short name, middle-sized name. Thought we'd got three operators on the call for a second.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Unfortunately it's just me, mate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you inspect the PRV on the boiler for leaks next week? Again, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep—sorry, just separating that from my completed inspection update. This is the leak inspection on the PRV on the boiler?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Separate job, next week, not reopening Tuesday's sign-off.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Understood. I'll inspect the PRV on the boiler for leaks next week.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I'll grease and check the bearings on the number two bearing today at 2pm. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped a bit there. Number two bearing?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the number two bearing. Grease and check the bearings on that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Grace Liu has that, today at 2pm, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Then there's the chiller on three. We need someone to run a function test on the chiller on three at half two. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't take that one. Just saying now, rather than it looking like I've agreed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nor can I, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take the function test? We haven't got an owner from that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, sorry. I can't commit to that one either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, nobody's taken it. It's still needed, and it's still safety critical. Not agreed to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, Callum, I talked over the time. Was that half two?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Half two, yes. And the urgency was straight away, safety critical. I'm raising it, not volunteering to do it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Leaving that explicitly unallocated, not marking it covered.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Callum, can you sort the training records for the new starters tomorrow, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters tomorrow. That's fine.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just the records, not another round of training sessions?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just sorting the records. No new sessions.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So tomorrow's agreed bits are the shift handover report round from Marc and the new starter training records from Callum.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, report's mine.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And records are mine, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any corrections to what's agreed, before we finish?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No. Just to be clear, water booster is still blocked, not quietly back on the list.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the belt replacement's still off. Nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: All good. Apart from the prospect of a wet tent, but that's not for this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Definitely outside our scope. Right, thanks everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers. Bye.
